title: Information-Efficient Transformers via Adaptive Token Pruning

contributions.purpose: 提出信息导向的 token 剪枝门控
contributions.mechanism: 轻量头估计每 token 预测熵,按固定预算 ρ 保留低熵(最判别)token,插在两层注意力之间(encoder-gate-encoder)
contributions.evaluation: 合成数据 ρ≈0.5:acc 0.551/AUC 0.556 略超全编码器(0.519/0.556)与 attention-sum(0.523/0.556);但准确率仅微超随机 0.5,差异极小
contributions.domain: 高效 Transformer / token 剪枝
contributions.source_quote: A lightweight head estimates per-token predictive entropy; tokens with the lowest entropy are preferentially retained under a fixed budget rho.

contributions.mechanism: 两层注意力 FLOPs 代理 + 解析延迟模型
contributions.evaluation: 合成 ρ=0.5 降 FLOPs 37.5%、延迟代理 73.21%;SST-2 ρ=0.75 降 FLOPs ~40% 但 acc 掉 8.7pp(0.914→0.827)
contributions.source_quote: On SST-2, a PyTorch implementation with rho=0.75 reduces estimated FLOPs by ~40% with accuracy 0.827 (vs. 0.914 baseline), illustrating a practical efficiency-accuracy trade-off.

notes: 数据红旗:合成实验的训练是伪造的——§6 明言 'Trainer creates realistic but lightweight learning curves by deterministically improving validation metrics across epochs',即准确率曲线由确定性脚本生成而非真实训练,故 acc 0.551 等合成结果不可信(且仅微超 0.5 随机水平)。trade-off 有数字:SST-2 掉 8.7pp。幻影统计:§9 大段统计流程(McNemar/DeLong/Wilson/Holm/bootstrap/power)标注为 'used (or recommended)',多为推荐未实做;正文声称 seeds{42-46}、mean±95%CI,但 checklist Q7 自曝 'Only pilot runs (synthetic, single-seed SST-2) reported; no error bars/confidence intervals yet'——正文与 checklist 直接矛盾=phantom 统计。参考文献仅 6 条含占位式('Survey: Efficient Transformers, various authors')。checklist AI 参与中等(多为 B,写作 C)。与 reject 一致。
